title: Gauntlet Dark Legacy — Alpha Setup
intro: Install the PC port using your own USA GameCube disc image (GUNE5D). No game data is downloaded. A Vulkan 1.3-capable graphics driver is required.
drop: Drop an .iso or .ciso here, or browse…
destination_help: Defaults to the folder containing this installer. Choose a writable folder. Existing installations and saves are never overwritten.
ready: Ready to install. Native game files, saves and configuration will live beside the game executable.
working: Validating the image and preparing installation…
cancelling: Cancelling and removing incomplete installation files…
complete: Installed {version}. Your game is ready. Saves: saves/ · Settings: config/settings.json
choose_image: Select your USA GameCube disc image
